title: Bee Removal in Hunts Point, Bronx
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Hunts Point, Bronx. Licensed technicians. Call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote.
intro: Hunts Point residents and business owners face stinging insect pressure from wasp, hornet, and yellow jacket colonies nesting in wall voids, soffits, and warehouse structures. The Best Pest Control NYC treats and removes active nests throughout Hunts Point — wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, carpenter bees, and ground-nesting bees — protecting homes, the Hunts Point Food Distribution Center area, and commercial properties. Our licensed technicians locate the nest, treat it, remove accessible material, and seal entry points to prevent recolonization.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC has served Hunts Point for years with specialized knowledge of the neighborhood's unique pest challenges, from waterfront properties to multi-family buildings. Our certified bee removal experts use safe, eco-friendly methods and offer transparent pricing between $350-$550, with no hidden fees and same-day service available.
localContext: Hunts Point's industrial zones near the Produce Market and residential blocks along Southern Boulevard offer abundant wasp and hornet nesting sites — building overhangs, warehouse eaves, older brownstone soffits, and wall voids. The neighborhood's proximity to the Bronx River and green spaces means wasp and yellow jacket activity peaks during spring and summer, with paper nests growing inside structures and ground yellow jacket colonies establishing in lawns and landscaping. Prompt treatment prevents large colonies from becoming aggressive defenders.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Hunts Point?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.
